turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to do a day hike on Sunday but I'm not super fit.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. There's a flat lakeside loop of about five miles, or a shorter trail with a steep climb and a great view. Which appeals more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Daniel something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So when's your driving test again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thursday. I can't sleep thinking about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You'll be fine. Is it the parallel parking that's worrying you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: All of it, honestly. Mostly the roundabouts. I freeze.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Want to go out tomorrow evening and just do roundabouts for an hour?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Would you really? That would help so much.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course. I'll bring snacks for afterwards.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Did you pick between the flat walk and the climb with the view?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The lake. I'd rather enjoy it than suffer.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Bring a picnic, there are benches along the shore.
